title: Objectwise ordinary compact-support coefficient balancing
statement: Fix a prime l and finite extensions E and F of Q_l with a Q_l-algebra map i. For every scheme W and every sheaf M of modules over its completed integral E-coefficient sheaf, extension of the restriction of M along the constant integral E-to-F map is isomorphic to the restriction of completed scalar extension of M. The isomorphism sends every local pure tensor b tensor x to completion(b) tensor x. Only the component isomorphisms and their generator formulas are asserted; naturality and uniqueness are established in the parent.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.2(1), Definition 3.4.10; finite integral-basis construction of the ordinary tensor comparison.

proof.text: Choose an integral A-basis b_i of B. The compatible finite quotient bases identify the completed coefficient sheaf S with the finite free R-module on the images of b_i. Therefore the multiplication map R tensor_A B to S is an isomorphism. For the fixed R-module sheaf M, tensor this coefficient isomorphism with M and use associativity. The forward map sends b tensor x to completion(b) tensor x. Write s uniquely as sum_i r_i completion(b_i); the inverse sends s tensor x to sum_i b_i tensor (r_i x). The basis multiplication matrices prove B-linearity and the balancing relation over R. The composites are identities on pure tensors, and restriction compatibility lets the maps descend through sheafification. This proves the component isomorphism and its section formula; it makes no assertion of naturality in M or uniqueness.
